card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The period used as a decimal point between digits of a number, such as 1.5 or 437.465. It fires on the dot when digits come before it and more digits follow.

modes.label: Dose and measure decimals
modes.description: Decimal point in a dose or strength, before a unit like mg or g.
modes.example: a single dose containing 1<<.>>0 mg of norethindrone

modes.label: General quantities
modes.description: Decimal point in areas, money, frequencies or counts in web text.

card.writes: It promotes dot-like symbols and suppresses commas, so the model expects a decimal point rather than a comma inside the number.
card.plain: It marks the decimal point inside a number, like the dot in 1.5 mg.
